items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls; it sees only the messages the program sends, so a removed result is simply absent. Answer a shows M1, that the model remembers earlier calls itself.

Call 1 sends 1,000 + 100 = 1,100. Call 2 adds 500: 1,600. Call 3 adds 500: 2,100. Total 1,100 + 1,600 + 2,100 = 4,800. An answer of 1,700 or 2,100 counts the new tokens or the last call only, forgetting that the whole history is re-sent each call (M1).

Information needed across sessions must be saved outside the window by the program and loaded back at the next session. A window lasts one run (a, c show M2). A shared manual library is for shared documents, not one student's status (d).

items.rationale: The model has not read the whole manual; it answers from the chunks placed in its window, so a wrong chunk gives a wrong answer. An answer saying the model read the manual and misremembered it shows M3.
Compaction summarizes the conversation and starts a new window from the summary, keeping the important details. It does not save a file (a), shrink tokens (b), or simply drop old messages (d).
